dataset.normalization: TranscriptForge pinned oligo RMA and highest-MAD gene aggregation
dataset.sample_scope: Four matched normal-human donors; superficial and deep zones only
dataset.download_policy: Raw CEL files are downloaded by accession and checksum; they are not redistributed in this repository.

signature.marker_source: Grogan et al., Zone-specific Gene Expression Patterns in Articular Cartilage, Arthritis Rheum. 2013;65:418-428.
signature.selection_timing: Frozen before running the signature benchmark; no genes are selected from TranscriptForge differential-expression output.
signature.validation_scope: The marker publication includes this cohort, so this is a public technical benchmark rather than independent biological validation.

default_method_policy.rationale: Prefer the first passing method in this fixed order. Mean z-score is transparent, preserves gene-set direction, reduces gene-baseline dominance within a cohort, and does not add an R runtime dependency. It remains cohort-dependent and does not create a portable raw threshold.
